messages:
nora_sre: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — consolidating action owners for GPU capacity and autoscale. Keeping this thread as the single source.

ashley_platform: I'll run the scheduler variant tests (staggered warmup + conservative scale-down). Will post staging results later today.

devon_scheduler: I'll own the quota request for dedicated eu-west. Plan: +4 GPUs staged (+2 now, +2 after 2 weeks). Draft PR by Thu.

maria_capacity: I'll run headroom sims including partner sync and ETL bursts (03:00 UTC). Deliver CSV + recommendation by Wed morning.

ben_oncall: I'll add a one-page emergency scale playbook with manual commands and a Slack shortcut to kick a warmup job. ETA: tomorrow.

olivia_pm: I'll coordinate with partners about shifting non-critical sync windows if sims show big gains.

infra-bot: Created INF-5011: "Tail mitigation + quota plan" (owner: nora_sre) | due 2024-07-11

nora_sre: Agreed owners/dates: scheduler tests @ashley_platform due 2024-07-11, quota PR @devon_scheduler due 2024-07-13, headroom sim @maria_capacity due 2024-07-10, ops playbook @ben_oncall due 2024-07-09.

ashley_platform: Canary plan: 10% -> 30% -> 100% over 36h. Health gates: no >6% regression in 99th latency and errors <0.5%. Config snippet I'll test on staging.

devon_scheduler: PR will include cost delta and staged rollout. Tagging finance in the PR for fast-track.

maria_capacity: Early sim: ETL spikes drive short tails needing ~3 extra GPUs; with a 1-GPU pre-warm we avoid most tail pressure. Full report uploaded to internal drive.

ben_oncall: Playbook added. Example manual step:
```
/ops/warmup start --pool=dedi-eu-west --units=2
kubectl wait --for=condition=ready pod -l app=inference -n redwood --timeout=300s
```

nora_sre: Two follow-ups: (1) test schedule shift in sim (Maria), (2) ensure quota PR adds alert for headroom crossing 75%. Keep links + canary logs here. Re-check in one week.
